description: Change a Panel: re-propose its content, change what it leaves out, or switch it between Item and Spot mode, in any combination. Re-proposing is how you resolve an ambiguous or broken Panel: resolve those you meet on a Workspace you're working on as part of your task, and any the user points you at. For an ambiguous Panel, give candidates from the ids read_workspace offers for it. Otherwise open its Source page (or another) with open_page and give that page with candidate ids from it. The page is used as add_panel uses it: the first Panel from it takes it over as its own, and it stays open to you for more Panels; from a page a Panel has taken, the Panel gets a fresh copy where Banquish replays your reveals and finds the parts again (refused if they aren't found, and the Panel gets its old content back). Several ids make a Composite Panel. exclude takes ids of candidates inside the chosen parts that the Panel leaves out. Given without candidates, exclude changes what the Panel leaves out of its parts, with ids from the page you made it from while that page is still open to you; [] brings everything back. mode is "item" (follow this specific thing) or "spot" (whatever occupies this place): from then on the Panel finds its content that way: at once, and again whenever its page loads. It answers within about 45 s: a change whose page is still loading then gives the Panel with "loading"; a later Fit report or read_workspace shows it settled. The Panel keeps its id and placement; place it with arrange.
name: update_panel
title: Update a Panel
